policy_decisions.proposal: Retain the 25 five-case requirement rows below as a proposed development-case annex. CCI, cadence, formulas, audit counts and exhaustive interval lists remain optional unless an item explicitly requires the relevant finding. New formal cases need separately approved case requirements before viewing their generated outputs.

Covered: the complete applicable semantic core is conveyed. Partially covered: a meaningful proper subset is conveyed. Not covered: none of the core is conveyed or only an unrelated statement appears. Cannot assess is an administrative state for missing/corrupt/mismatched materials, not uncertainty about physiology. No numeric points or weights are assigned.

Require all AND components; accept one complete OR route, including the specified mixed ST/VL routes. For Sub49 C06, keep missing-field statements conditional on discussion of those domains. Apply G03 to all five reference-bearing tasks; silence about reference comparisons is not an exemption.

G03 needs both comparability limitation and inference limitation, stated once or across sections. Age and speed keywords are not individually compulsory. C01 separately assesses the case speed and its relationship to reference support. One sentence can support both; do not require repeated caveats or add a duplicate error for the same claim.

Credit appropriate uncertainty without demanding unavailable normal limits. It does not replace a required factual finding. Use model-visible precision and clinical meaning, not hidden full-precision values or pixel-derived facts. Do not treat max |z|>2 as abnormal or a pooled percentile as a matched LOO threshold.

Record required content and unsupported assertions separately. A later incorrect interpretation does not erase an already conveyed core. A wrong or absent required component prevents full coverage of that component; log the false assertion separately without adding a second numerical penalty. Merge repeated equivalent claims about the same case finding; split independently assessable claims and link them.

Assess errors in subject-specific factual and interpretive assertions under the approved instructions. Method/design guarantees and output-format problems receive separate design-concern or format records, not silent additions to case-error counts. This preserves the scope distinction seen in Q018 without endorsing its assertion. Experts must confirm this prospective choice.

Each rater records evidence quotes/locations, reasoning and explicit completion separately. Unresolved issues remain pending, not confirmed errors. No severity weights, composite score, partial-credit percentage, error rate denominator or statistical analysis is approved by this rubric. Both experts must approve the rubric separately from the already approved prompt.

error_categories.name: Invented or misreported facts
error_categories.scope: Invented values, channels, side, gait events or diagnoses presented as observed; incorrect arithmetic, metric identity or signed direction.
error_categories.boundary: A data discrepancy is checked against the exact saved input; not every harmless rounding difference is an error.

error_categories.name: Unsupported clinical or functional inference
error_categories.scope: Spasticity, weakness, contracture, compensation or treatment recommendation not supported by this limited input; speed band asserted as measured independence or safety.
error_categories.boundary: A genuine open assessment question is allowed. A question that presupposes an observed deficit is evaluated in context.

error_categories.name: Threshold or amplitude overinterpretation
error_categories.scope: Threshold coverage converted to physiological onset/duration, tonic contraction, absence of rest, force, weakness or stride variability.
error_categories.boundary: Above-threshold coverage is a mean-envelope property. The duration rule removes short above-threshold runs, not short below-threshold gaps.

error_categories.name: Unsupported event, phase or function
error_categories.scope: Assigning toe-off, stance/swing or phase-specific clearance/push-off to percentages without evidence; confusing max-z location with amplitude peak.
error_categories.boundary: Documented initial-contact boundary and anatomical muscle actions are allowed as in v3.1; healthy pooled-cycle qualification applies.

error_categories.name: Invalid reference or diagnostic classification
error_categories.scope: Max |z|>2 called abnormal; hidden muscle-specific limits imported; clinical normality established from empirical percentiles; LOO equated with matching.
error_categories.boundary: Relative-to-mean direction and supplied endpoint comparisons remain allowed; descriptive exceedance is not diagnosis.

error_categories.name: CCI overinterpretation
error_categories.scope: Within-range CCI asserted as physiological normal co-activation; outside-range CCI asserted as pathology/stiffness; time-percentage interpretation or transferred thresholds.
error_categories.boundary: Within/below/above the supplied interval and proximity to endpoints are allowed. Prospective wording does not reopen Q055.

error_categories.name: Kinematic summary overinterpretation
error_categories.scope: GVS/ROM used to localize unseen waveform direction/phase or establish restriction, cause or overall normality.
error_categories.boundary: Report supplied GVS/ROM separately and compare visible values; no image-only finding is required.

error_categories.name: Missingness or applicability error
error_categories.scope: Absent EMG filled with zero or normality; expert reference curves treated as participant data; a task-inapplicable paretic index invented for a control.
error_categories.boundary: Explicitly unavailable is correct content for Sub47. General left/right symmetry is not impossible in controls.

error_categories.name: Unsupported matching or disease attribution
error_categories.scope: Speed inside a cohort range treated as actual matching or proof of negligible confounding; deviation wholly attributed to stroke.
error_categories.boundary: G03 caveats may be covered elsewhere and the assertion can still be an error. Unknown control speed cannot establish matching.
